files.delete.permanent_edited: {path} is deleted with your uncommitted changes; Glowfly keeps a copy so Undo{hint} brings them back. Discarding the deletion instead brings back its staged or committed version. A file over 64 MB is too large to keep a copy of, so Glowfly asks again before deleting one.
files.delete.permanent_untracked: {path} isn't tracked by Git. Glowfly keeps a copy so Undo{hint} can bring it back while this tab is open. A file over 64 MB is too large to keep a copy of, so Glowfly asks again before deleting one.
files.discard.permanent_body: {path} isn't tracked by Git. Discarding it deletes it; Glowfly keeps a copy so Undo{hint} can bring it back while this tab is open. A file over 64 MB is too large to keep a copy of, so Glowfly asks again before deleting one.
files.folder_menu.stage_conflicted: Resolve the conflicted files in this folder first.
files.hazard.not_utf8.label: name isn't UTF-8
files.hazard.not_utf8.left_staged.one: {count} file whose name isn't UTF-8 stays staged: Glowfly can't unstage it safely. Use Git on the command line.
files.hazard.not_utf8.left_staged.other: {count} files whose names aren't UTF-8 stay staged: Glowfly can't unstage them safely. Use Git on the command line.
files.hazard.not_utf8.reason: This file's name isn't UTF-8, so Glowfly can't act on it safely; use Git on the command line.
files.hazard.twins.label: same file as another path
files.hazard.twins.reason: This file system can't tell this path from {paths}: they are one file on disk. Rename one of them in Git first.
files.menu.restore_from.tip: {to} doesn't have this file, so this brings back its version from {from}.
files.menu.restore_from_empty.tip: This range runs back to an empty repository, so this brings back the file's version from {from}.
files.menu.revert_between.tip: Undo the changes between these commits to the file in your working copy.
files.menu.revert_file.tip: Undo this commit's changes to the file in your working copy. The commit itself is not changed.
files.menu.unsafe_name: Glowfly can't name this path to Git safely
files.menu.unsafe_stash: Glowfly can't stash this path safely
files.no_copy_kept.body: {path} is over 64 MB, so Glowfly can't keep a copy for Undo, and nothing was deleted. Delete it permanently anyway? This can't be undone.
files.not_in_workdir: Not in your working tree (deleted, renamed or never checked out)
files.trash_refused.confirm_no_copy: {path} is over 64 MB, so Glowfly kept no copy for Undo. Delete it permanently? This can't be undone.
files.trash_refused.home_no_copy: Or delete it permanently, which can't be undone: it's over 64 MB, so Glowfly kept no copy for Undo.
files.trash_refused.no_copy: Delete it permanently instead? It's over 64 MB, so Glowfly kept no copy for Undo: this can't be undone.
files.tree.staged.show_list.name: Show staged files as list
files.tree.staged.show_tree.name: Show staged files as tree
files.tree.unstaged.show_list.name: Show unstaged files as list
files.tree.unstaged.show_tree.name: Show unstaged files as tree
files.unstage_delete.permanent_new: {path} is a new file in the staging area. Deleting it also takes it out of the staging area; Undo{hint} brings back both. A file over 64 MB is too large to keep a copy of, so Glowfly asks again before deleting one.
files.unstage_delete.permanent_renamed: {path} is staged as a rename. Deleting it also unstages the rename: the file it was renamed from stays deleted in your working tree as an unstaged change, and discarding that brings back its committed version. Undo{hint} brings back the file and the staged rename. A file over 64 MB is too large to keep a copy of, so Glowfly asks again before deleting one.
files.unstage_gone.body: {path} is staged as a new file but is no longer in your working tree. This removes it from the staging area too; Undo{hint} stages it again.
files.warnings.elsewhere: Some tracked paths differ only in case or Unicode form ({paths}); they can't both be checked out on Windows or macOS.
files.warnings.shared: One file on this disk stands for several tracked paths ({paths}). Discard, delete and restore are off for them.
files.warnings.submodules_unread: Submodules aren't shown: a .gitmodules file here or in a submodule isn't a plain file Glowfly can read.
files.warnings.title: File names
